description: This file defines the UpgradeCommand class which extends the InstallerCommand class. It is responsible for managing the upgrade process of the OrangeHRM system via a CLI command, handling database connection, version selection, system checks, and migration execution.

classes.name: UpgradeCommand
classes.description: A console command class for orchestrating the upgrade process of the OrangeHRM system, including database setup, system checks, version migration, and configuration updates.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the name of the CLI command, setting its alias to 'upgrade'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Defines the command-line options necessary for the upgrade process, such as database credentials and current version.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution method that runs the upgrade sequence, including system checks, user prompts, database connection validation, migration execution, and configuration file updates.

methods.name: drawDatabaseInfoTable
methods.description: Helper method to output the database connection information in a tabular format.

methods.name: hasOption
methods.description: Utility to check if an option parameter is set and non-empty.

methods.name: throwIfParamEmpty
methods.description: Utility method to throw an exception if a required parameter is missing or empty.
